name: After § 5
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 5a. Deplores the lack of action by the European Union and the United States in the face of the Israeli authorities’ continuous attempts to undermine and discredit the UN, its Secretary-General and, especially, the United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East (UNRWA); deplores the legislation adopted by the Knesset banning the activities of UNRWA and ceasing its relations with Israeli authorities; deplores the dire consequences this will have for the region, as UNRWA is the main humanitarian assistance structure in Gaza and the West Bank, on which millions of people depend for vital services; recalls that this legislation infringes international law; rejects the suspension of funding to UNRWA and calls for the EU and its Member States to support UNRWA with adequate funding to continue and improve its life-saving humanitarian work;
